svg.title: UnityPSF modality-routed expert-parallel PSF localization
svg.desc: A publication-style scientific figure showing axial PSF manifolds, deterministic modality and channel routing, complete experts placed on independent GPUs, sparse conditional parameter activation, and a joint checkpoint indexing independent expert states.
svg.text: UnityPSF couples modality-routed conditional localization with expert-parallel training
One PSF sample activates one complete expert; one distributed job updates all PSF families concurrently.
Distinct PSF families occupy distinct axial image manifolds
Static modality routing places complete localization experts on independent GPUs
deterministic hard route · zero trainable gate parameters
No shared backbone or cross-expert gradient; synchronization occurs only at epoch and checkpoint boundaries.
Routing is sparse per sample, not across the distributed training job
expert instance selected by r(modality, channel)
one non-zero decision per channel sample
five trained instances in the final bundle
all three ranks may compute concurrently,
while each sample remains conditionally sparse
One logical checkpoint indexes independent expert and physical states
modality-routed hard MoE, expert-parallel training, channel-isolated scientific states.
learned top-k routing, shared-backbone sparsity, or cross-expert gradient coupling.
Per-sample conditional computation preserves PSF-specific physics while a single distributed run trains all supported modalities.
